$comment: Canned replies for the stand-in platform (demo/fake-platform.js in the case desk engine), so this desk can be tried with no platform. Each key is a distinctive part of a case title, matched without regard to case. The stand-in adds its own first line saying that the reply is canned. The replies follow the right answers in demo-bank/SCENARIOS.md. The bank, its customers and its cards are invented. Start the stand-in with DESK_CONFIG pointing at desk.config.json in this folder.

The records fit the pattern of rule FRD-RULE-001 and fit the customer's account. A payment record does not say who made the payment. Message to the customer. Draft. Not sent. Dear Marguerite Oakhaven, We have looked at the three online card payments made in Norvania on 22 Nov 2026, USD 2,219.90 in all, which you told us you did not make. Nothing has been done to your card yet, and we will send nothing further until the analyst has decided. Meridian Trust Bank, fraud team Recommendation: refund the three card payments, which also blocks the card, and offer a replacement card. The records point to fraud: three online payments abroad at night on a card used only in person at home before, and two calls from her home number. The fraud analyst decides.
